name: RICCO Industrial Area
discoveryMethod: First-party English and Hindi discovery, Rajasthan/RIICO custodian review, official viewer configuration inspection, and bounded anonymous ArcGIS REST service attempts.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery languages found the official Rajasthan Rajdharaa and RIICO GIS routes. The RIICO viewer configuration was retrieved and exposed the configured production ArcGIS services and plot layer IDs. Direct requests to the configured gisprod host timed out, so no layer schema, parcel ID, or geometry was obtained. Independent locality search supports the Kishangarh/Ajmer context but is not used as parcel evidence.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: RIICO, Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation Limited, is the local industrial-area land/map custodian evidenced by its official GIS viewer and official land-allotment site.
sourceAssessment.publicService: Official viewer configuration points to RIICOProdLyr and RIICOERP ArcGIS MapServer services on gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in; configured plot boundary layer is feature class 53 and ERP data layer is 1.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: None. The service host timed out before layer metadata or fields could be read.
